law: providers are optional advisory resources; FREE_FIRST (cost=0 first) where capability permits; NO provider superiority is hard-coded — strengths count toward routing ONLY when backed by probe_ids; unprobed strength claims are ignored, not believed; paid providers are never a hard dependency and never appear silently (allow_paid flag, default false)

notes.strengths: list of {capability, claim, probe_ref|null}; claim ignored by the router when probe_ref is null
notes.provider_id: convention: the registry mapping key IS the provider_id (no duplicated literals)

safety.numeric_provenance_law: every numeric_claim must reference >=1 entry in evidence_refs; otherwise the claim verdict is INVALID
safety.deterministic_floor: all providers failing => DETERMINISTIC_ONLY; AHOS continues safely; AI is an accelerator, never the foundation

cost_law.free_is_not_forever: availability/cost are probe-measured per interval, never assumed permanent
